note: Fresh end-to-end test batch using the regenerated worker/finalize pipeline.

items.name: Bay Area Builders LLC
items.summary: Roofing/remodeling Wix site has real service-area/contact details but visible placeholder copy and fake testimonials, making a trust cleanup highly pitchable.
items.angle: keep the M&B-style contractor layout while replacing placeholder text/testimonials, clarifying roofing/remodel paths, and making the free-estimate flow credible.

items.name: Miami Frameless Shower Doors
items.summary: Custom shower-door site has phone/email and project photos but multiple template paragraphs and weak service hierarchy hurt trust.
items.angle: preserve the simple blue/white contractor feel while replacing placeholders with shower-door services, trust cues, project paths, and a clearer free-quote CTA.

items.name: Grind Nation Moving LLC
items.summary: Local delivery/moving site has a memorable brand line and real contact details, but the quote path and service organization feel thin and template-driven.
items.angle: keep the bold moving-template structure while clarifying local delivery/storage paths, insured trust cues, and what happens after requesting an estimate.

items.name: Clint’s Automotive & Fabrication LLC
items.summary: Auto repair site has real shop contact, payment info, and estimate intent, but opens around a generic price-quote block and template wording.
items.angle: retain the practical shop style while foregrounding repair/fabrication services, veteran discount/trust, hours/location, and a specific quote request flow.

items.name: The Nauti Details, LLC
items.summary: Marine detailing site has a strong story and contact form but the first screen is vague and the detailed quote form can use clearer package/next-step framing.
items.angle: keep the boat-cleaning imagery and friendly story while tightening hero, service choices, trust proof, and quote-form expectations.

items.name: Harvest Accounting LLC
items.summary: Bookkeeping site has credible QuickBooks/industry details but buries the strongest trust/fit cues in paragraph copy with a generic Wix footer.
items.angle: keep the simple professional bookkeeping feel while clarifying wine-industry and SMB paths, ProAdvisor proof, consultation CTA, and next steps.

items.name: Clean Freak Services LLC
items.summary: Cleaning site has real contact info and services but includes generic Service Name booking blocks and confusing mixed cleaning/detailing options.
items.angle: preserve the straightforward cleaning-service template while removing generic booking leftovers, grouping services by buyer intent, and strengthening free-estimate action.

items.name: Premier Fitness
items.summary: Fitness site has real coaching credibility and program options but the homepage can make the first-step CTA, program paths, and coach trust easier to scan.
items.angle: keep the dark/athletic Wix feel and real coach material while clarifying group, personal, and online training paths plus a consultation next step.

items.name: Zensai Kauai Style LLC
items.vertical: local food, poke, plate lunches, catering
items.summary: Food site has authentic local flavor, menu imagery, and contact info, but the homepage hides catering/opening-hours action and has duplicated menu/nav cues.
items.angle: preserve the casual local food style while clarifying daily specials, catering/pupu platter CTA, hours, location, and what to ask for when contacting.

items.name: JBM Landscape & Irrigation, LLC
items.summary: Irrigation site has real project photos, TCEQ regulatory info, and contact details but the first screen and service path are sparse and gallery-heavy.
items.angle: keep the project-photo contractor feel while adding clearer sprinkler/landscape service cards, regulated/licensed trust cues, estimate CTA, and next steps.
